description: AL Language debug adapter configuration for Business Central. Schema extracted from Microsoft AL Language extension v18.
$comment: Only fields consumed by the native adapter are exposed. Microsoft-only launch fields remain available by opting into al.useOfficialDap and using the Microsoft adapter's own configuration surface.

label.description: Display name for this debug configuration

request.description: Debug request type. `launch` publishes and debugs, or replays a snapshot when `snapshotFileName` is set. `attach` connects to a running session, or records a snapshot when `snapshot` is `capture`.

build.description: Build step to run before debugging

authentication.description: Native DAP uses OAuth bearer authentication. Use al.useOfficialDap=true when Windows or UserPassword authentication is required.

breakOnError.description: Specifies whether the debugger to break on the next error. Accepts the string mode (`All`/`ExcludeTry`/`None`/etc.) or a boolean (`true` ≈ `All`, `false` ≈ `None`).

breakOnNext.description: Specifies that attach should break on the next available client session. With snapshot `capture` it is required and the kind of session to record next (Agent cannot be recorded).

breakOnRecordWrite.description: Specifies whether the debugger breaks on record changes. Accepts the string mode (`All`/`ExcludeTemporary`/`None`/etc.) or a boolean (`true` ≈ `All`, `false` ≈ `None`).

dependencyPublishingOption.description: Specifies the publishing option to use. By specifying the Ignore option, only the current project is published, dependencies are ignored. By specifying the Strict option, publishing will fail if the project has apps that not part of the workspace and depend on it

enableLongRunningSqlStatements.description: Specifies whether the debugger enables or disables long running SQL statements in the debugger window.

enableSqlInformationDebugger.description: Specifies whether the debugger shows the SQL Information in the debugger.

environmentName.description: Specifies which production, or sandbox environment to use.

environmentType.description: Specifies which environment to use to connect to Business Central.

launchBrowser.description: If the value is set to true, the browser tab is launched, if false, the browser tab is not launched. If publishing with debugging enabled, the browser tab is launched and this setting is ignored. The default value is true.

longRunningSqlStatementsThreshold.description: Sets the number of milliseconds spent before a SQL statement is considered as long running in the debugger.

numberOfSqlStatements.description: Sets the number of SQL statements to be shown in the debugger.

schemaUpdateMode.description: Specifies the update mode to use when the extension is already installed.

serverInstance.description: The server instance to connect to.

sessionId.description: For attach requests, the id of the BC client session to attach to. Use -1 (the default) to attach via `breakOnNext` instead of a specific session. With snapshot `capture`, the server session to record.

startupCompany.description: Specifies the name of the company which should be opened after publishing.

startupObjectId.description: Specifies the ID of the object which should be opened after publishing.

startupObjectType.description: Specifies the type of the object which should be opened after publishing.

tenant.description:
The tenant to connect to.
For an on-premise server, this parameter must contain a tenant name, for example: MyTenant.
For a cloud server, this parameter must contain the Microsoft Entra tenant ID or Primary Domain associated with the Microsoft Entra tenant, for example: bf4ab6d6-cd93-424e-91fa-afe03fa286ac or mycustomer.onmicrosoft.com

validateServerCertificate.description: If the value is set to false, the server certificate will not be validated.

acceptInvalidCerts.description: The inverse of validateServerCertificate, accepted for parity with the AL CLI. Setting it to true disables TLS certificate verification for every request the native debug session makes to Business Central, so a man-in-the-middle can read and alter the session. Setting both this and validateServerCertificate to the same value is a configuration error.

snapshot.description: Attach only. `capture` records a snapshot instead of debugging: the breakpoints you set become snappoints, the capture arms when the configuration finishes, and disconnecting finishes it and saves the zip to snapshotOutputPath. Requires breakOnNext. A capture only records, so it does not step or show variables. Replay the zip with a launch that sets snapshotFileName.

userId.description: With snapshot `capture`: record only this user's session, given as a user security ID (GUID) or a user name. Without it the next session of any user on the tenant is recorded.

snapshotVerbosity.description: With snapshot `capture`: SnapPoint records variables at the snappoints and where an exception is held. Full also records every call.

snapshotOutputPath.description: With snapshot `capture`: the folder for the saved snapshot zip, inside the project. A relative path is relative to the project root. A .gitignore is written into a folder the capture creates.

snapshotFileName.description: Launch only: replay this snapshot zip instead of publishing and debugging. A relative path is relative to the project root. Nothing is compiled or published and no token is read.

snapshotPort.description: With snapshot `capture` on an on-premises server: the port of the snapshot debugger services. The default is 7083.

allowProduction.description: With snapshot `capture`: allow a capture on a Production environment. Without it a Production target is refused before any sign-in.
